items.title: El Niño declared by BOM, and it could become the strongest on record
items.description: El Niño is a state which can linger for up to 12 months and disrupt weather patterns across the globe, with Australia especially prone.

items.title: Trump's 'American flag blue' Reflecting Pool turns green after renovation
items.description: A $20 million renovation of Washington, DC's Reflecting Pool set out to fix leaks and turn the water blue. Mother Nature had other plans.

items.title: Two men arrested by Dezi Freeman investigators
items.description: Police executed seven warrants at properties across Victoria and New South Wales this morning.

items.title: Iran's players celebrated at World Cup but complicated feelings remain
items.description: After a challenging, politically charged build-up to their World Cup campaign Iran's 2-2 draw with New Zealand brought mixed feelings for the Iranian diaspora.

items.title: Birth doula says lack of consent delayed Triple Zero call for dying mother
items.description: A court probing the death of Stacey Warnecke after a freebirth has heard that emergency care was delayed for several minutes because her "birth keeper" would only call an ambulance if she consented.

items.title: Solomon Islands PM floats Pacific-wide security treaty in sharp pivot
items.description: Solomon Islands's new prime minister raises the idea of a Pacific-wide security treaty while meeting Prime Minister Anthony Albanese this month.

items.title: Eight crew believed dead in California B-52 bomber crash
items.description: A US Air Force B-52 bomber, designed to carry nuclear and conventional weapons, crashes shortly after taking off at an air base.

items.title: The war has been a disaster for Trump and his aims in Iran are unmet
items.description: The ceasefire agreement fits a pattern from Donald Trump where the signing of a deal appears to be the major goal and the details often seem a distant secondary consideration.

items.title: Live: Interest rates stay steady but RBA leaves door open to further hikes
items.description: The Reserve Bank has kept interest rates on hold at 4.35 per cent at its June meeting, providing a reprieve for borrowers after three consecutive rate hikes, with local shares flat despite a Wall Street rally overnight. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: Live: PM confirms Treasury will release discussion paper for 'further input' on CGT changes
items.description: Anthony Albanese says Treasury will release a discussion paper for "further input" on CGT changes, after Finance Minister Katy Gallagher reveals an extension to the fuel excise cut is under "active consideration". Follow live.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
